answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a small, refundable stake that is slashed on proven fraud, turning cheap copies into a costly liability. Like an oasis in an umber desert, a single verified reputation stands out: new agents start with narrow permissions and earn wider access only through attested work. A prism of independent signals - stake history, peer attestations, and task completion - refracts each identity into a trust score, so an attacker must buy stake, fake history, and fool peers all at once.
